nom: Undefined Beauty R&R Sun Serum Tinted Mineral SPF 50 PA++++

avis.texte: First off, like the last review, I received a product that expired 6/2026 on 6/2/2026. I used it for about a week to give it a chance. It felt heavy and wet on my face. I would let it sit for 30-45 minutes and my face still had a layer of oil on it. The hair touching my face would become greasy thus making my hair look unkept. It just didnt feel great on my skin and I couldn't get past that.

It is concerning that the company has been unable to restock the light shade. When I contacted them, they explained that the current inventory comes from a single batch that expires in June 2026 and that they have not yet placed a new manufacturing order. They suggested purchasing one of the darker shades instead; however, as someone with very fair skin, that is not a practical solution. Skin tones can vary significantly, and consumers cannot simply substitute a darker shade and expect it to be suitable for everyone.
I've been looking for a tinted face moisturizer for a while. I like the richness of this serum and how easily it blends into my skin. It gives my skin a beautiful glow too.

I have been kind of sunscreen obsessed, for years, since a dermatologist told me to wear good sunscreen daily, even on cloudy days and I have followed this advice for decades. I came across Undefined maybe a year ago. It has become my go-to every morning, after I brush my teeth. I love the consistency, the quality, how it makes my skin look nourished. I typically don't wear foundation, but when I do, I wait 15 mins, to let the sunscreen do its thing and then I add foundation which stays nicely without interference from my Undefined sunscreen. Undefined is a gem. I hope it never gets discontinued because I am a believer.

What a blessing that I "accidentally" the undefined R & R sun serum. I have the tinted and recently bought the untinted/ cream sun serum to use as my sunblock. I love how it gives me protects me not only from the sun but also is healthy for my skin by having natural ingredients. Thank you for the creator (s) of these products!
The is pretty dang close to my holy grail sunscreen! I love how light and moisturizing it feels. I can use it both in the warmer humid months and the cooler dryer months. Great product!

Since they updated this product by taking away the final shine it is my absolute favorite sunscreen. It's water resistant, it's moisturizing, it has a light tint that looks so nice on my fair skin and it protects me.

avis.titre: The best SPF I've ever had
avis.texte: Easy to apply Comfortable to wear all day Does not irritate my sensitive skin I have 2 versions, in a light shade for the face, and without tint - for the neck (so as not to stain clothes) Like all other SPFs with physical filters, it has a specific scent, but it doesn't bother me

I have sensitive skin and can't use all chemical spfs and some mineral spfs. This spf doesn't irritate my skin and feels so good on my skin. It holds up all day long and reapplies with no pilling or heaviness. My skin is considered normal/dry and I find this sunscreen to be moisturizing without being greasy. The light shade is a perfect match for my skin and this sunscreen hardly oxides especially compared to other tinted mineral spfs I've tried. I also love the sheerness of the tint as I prefer a natural finish. I also find the price to be fair for the quality of this sunscreen. Please never discontinue or change this sunscreen!

This is the third shipment in a row where I received an expired SPF or almost expiring from Ulta. I received this product on May 28, 2026 and it expires June 2026. Also, the company makes it incredibly difficult to even read the expiration date which feels intentionally deceptive.

The best mineral sunscreen that is 50+ and water resistant! If youre oily dont use a moisturizer under it but i do use it with mousturizer bc i need extra moisture. Its nice and glowy but not greasy and not white at all!

I bought this on a whim because I needed a new spf and this was clean, but less expensive than a lot of the others I was looking at or have bought in the past. I was shocked at how much I loved it from the start, and am about to order my second bottle now. I've used Supergoop, Beauty of Joseon, Innbeauty, Good Molecules, and a ton of other spfs and tinted moisturizers of varying price and quality, and this blows them all away. It has great coverage, high SPF for my pale and sensitive 36-year-old skin, feels lovely on my skin, and has definitely improved my overall skin texture a bit as well. Plus I love the ingredients and brand.

avis.titre: It's like bb cream, but lighter
avis.texte: I've done makeup for 10+ years and i loveeeee a lightweight tint and this is my go to when i want something natural! I know most of the reviews say its dewy (which it is) but if you finish it off with some finishing powder you're set!! Especially if you do your regualr makeup routine on top of it - makes it look even better (:

avis.titre: Pls make a matte finish version!
avis.texte: Honestly the product is great, it does hydrated and protects the skin, the ONLY reason I returned the product is because it left my skin too shiny and I have oily skin. Even using a matte primer the shine was still there. Hope one day they create a matte version because I will definitely buy that one.

This spf is wayyy too dewy for me. I would go so far as to say it's past dewy, more wet finish. It never dries down and therefore ended up moving around on my face. I tried powdering to set, but it created a really awful texture. The light tint was a really great match for me (fair-light with cool undertones), but it also had a strange smell. Overall, just not for me!

[Combination skin, Fitzpatrick 4] Leaving this glowing review because I need this sunscreen to be available forever. I have tried a MYRIAD of tinted mineral sunscreens over the years - Beauty of Joseon, EltaMD, Ultra Violette, Australian Gold, DRMTLGY, Purlisse, and Bliss, to name a few - and I have consistently gone back to this one. I love it even more after they added Hectorite Clay. The texture is silky and it goes on like a dream, wearing wonderfully with or without makeup. I use the medium shade, which is perfect for my skin. Once it sets, it doesn't transfer into my light-colored clothes, which makes it perfect for summer. Plus, unlike a lot of other SPF, this one also makes it possible to use the correct 2-finger amount without looking like the peanut butter baby - just blend one finger at a time! I also love that this SPF is travel-friendly but lasts a long time, thanks to its fluid formula. Finally, the price point is AMAZING, considering that this also includes antioxidant boosters and other skincare ingredients. In general, I can't say enough good things about the R&R Sun Serum. I want this to be available forever, please and thank you! Some extra caveats and tips: - It can feel overly dewy at first, but give it 20 minutes to "set" (as you should with any SPF). After that, it leaves the prettiest glass-skin finish. If my combination skin is acting up, I just dab on a bit of powder or use a blotting paper. - The formula does contain tridecyl salicylate, which I bel

This is a great sunscreen for everyday wear and reapplication! The texture is great for layering with or without makeup. I have rosacea and this has prevented flare ups from sun exposure so I will be repurchasing as long as they make it!
This sadly burned my eyes pretty bad, but it felt and looked nice on the skin overall.
This product is runny and its a mess. Not into runny products running through my hands or face.
The only "light" option isnt a good fot for all European or light skin tones. It says its neutral but it leans pink/cool.

For those who love a dewy/shiny finish, you're good. But for girls like me who have textured and/or oily skin, this is a big nope. And that's really the only negative. Otherwise, this would be the perfect sunscreen. The medium was a great match for my skin tone, nice thin formula, didn't pill, good ingredients, comfortable on skin, SPF 50/PA++++, water-resistant. Really, it has all the makings of an HG, but I just can't pull off this shiny look. PLEASE, please make it in a natural matte or invisible finish. I beg of you!

I have tried many sunscreens, I have many sunscreens. I will happily keep this in the rotation. It didn't leave a cast on my skin, though I can only speak for the light shade. It felt moisturizing (I do wear it on top of actual moisturizer) without feeling thick/greasy like some SPF. It was not irritating at all. Overall- solid choice.
i love this product! the packaging it's self is so cute, the formula is amazing i love the way it feels on my skin!
after two uses... the product separated every time I used it. extremely oily and just doesn't perform. sad. I wanted to love it.

This is my first bottle of this sunscreen. While the consistency is thinner than I am used to, I find it applies pretty smoothly and is not too drying. I was concerned about the tint, but it has blended fine on my medium neutral skin tone.
Im in love with this tinted sunscreen. It's more on the thin side and leaves a nice glow. It doesn't pill. I love the fact its skin loving ingredients and not toxic.

avis.titre: I would recommend this product to everyone.
avis.texte: Me and my mom are fan of this product. We love undefined sunscreen ❤️
Love this product!! I love that its lightweight with a slight tint and just amazing on my skin.. i loveeeeee it

avis.titre: I don't get why people like this
avis.texte: It's runny (watery) and separates- the scent is awful and there is very little of it. If you are using the recommended amount it doesnt last long.
I like how lightweight this is on me. No wonder why I've heard only good things. It also makes my skintone more even.
Great product - decent price & works well. Wore in Aruba and no sunburn :). I also like the packaging
omg i love the sun serum sm its so lightweight while also providing spf protection

avis.titre: I would buy This product again
avis.texte: I love this product too much because it does not have a thick texture and it is not one of those that leave the skin white. I love it because it protects me all day and also because it makes me not feel when I have it on my face, although I also apply it on my neck

avis.titre: Love the after glow of the sunscreen 🤭
avis.texte: I love how the sunscreen doesn't sting my eyes and it absorbed so well into my skin, and I haven't been sunburnt even when I don't reapply 🥹❤️
This spf has a great formula but the only thing is that I looked really orange when I put this on but It was probably my fault.

The Undefined Beauty R&R Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Sun Serum R&R gives your skin a natural glow. It evens out your skin tone and is incredibly hydrating. Its lightweight and the non-greasy formula absorbs quickly, making it a perfect replacement for a moisturizer.
I have tried it from a friend and it is incredible, it leaves your skin as if you were wearing nothing but it works wonderfully, in the light tone

I couldn't get over the smell of the product and the tacky feeling on my face. I'm not sure why people are saying it's moisturizing because it made my skin feel very dry. I also had acne flare ups - I can't say for sure it was this product but it seems like more than a coincidence.
I tried Undefined Beauty's Sun Serum and loved it! It's lightweight, absorbs quickly, and offers great sun protection. My skin feels hydrated and it works well under makeup. Highly recommend!

absolutely love serum based products so this was a no-brainer for me. Packaging is sturdy. It's easy to squeeze the tube and I really like the small dropper at the top which makes it easy to control how much product I put on. It doesn't dry me out, which is pretty common around my nose and eyebrows when using liquid facial products
I love this product. I dont need a separate moisturizer with this. It protects and moisturizes my skin

avis.titre: Nice formula but wrong finish for oily skin
avis.texte: I purchased this because I read comments that this was good for oily skin. This formula is very honey like in texture and emollient. The finish is very shiny under my makeup. I am sure it us a good product but i do not recommend for oily skin or someone who is concerned with shine.
Great skin protection. Doesn't feel too heavy on the skin and doesn't leave a greasy effect. I also like that it's a higher SPF so I know i'm getting the most protection for my skin.
I love these product !! This brand is worth it 😍 you should order now everything 'nnn😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍

avis.titre: I WOULD BIT THIS AGAIN AND AGAIN
avis.texte: it is so gorgeous on your skin and protect you from the sun completely works so effectively and I love the ingredients
Love how this gives me spf with no white cast! Feels so light on the face! Perf for summer!

This was my summer of 2024 go to product It works amazing for us sunscreen obssesed girlies that still want to get some sun I love this brand and all of rheir products The fact its a spf 50 is amazing I literally felt safe out there

avis.titre: I love this product so much!!!
avis.texte: This tinted sunscreen is a game-changer! It provides excellent sun protection while offering a natural, even-toned finish. Lightweight and non-greasy, it blends seamlessly into the skin, leaving a radiant glow. Perfect for daily use, it keeps skin protected and flawless.
Left my skin glowing! Would definitely recommend this product.
Great texture that fits well with different skin types and overall just a great product.

avis.titre: Literally sunscreen and serum in one?!
avis.texte: I love how this is a fusion of sunscreen and a serum which is so amazing. I love how it also doesn't leave a white cast. I think this is so amazing to have especially when it is SPF 50. It is so hydrating and dewy when you put it on your skin. A literal slay!

The Undefined Beauty R&R Sun Serum is an innovative product that combines skincare benefits with sun protection. As someone who values natural ingredients and effective skincare, I found this product to be a refreshing addition to my daily routine.

Love the formula of this, my skin doesn't feel overburdened and it actually feels really soft, but the lightest shade is still too dark/warm on me. I'm very pale so this might not be an issue for most people - if it was a couple shades lighter and more of a true neutral, this would be a holy grail item for me.

I tried this product before and it was much too greasy and orange for me. This new formula in the lightest shade is not just sheer but it seems to be less oily to me. It feels very protective meaning you can detect the sunscreen film on the skin. I however like that because I need strong protection qith the medicine I am on. Love this brand and their price point!

I ordered this and have been wearing it daily for about 2 weeks. The claims are amazing: No sulfates, no silicones, no parabens. The ingredients are great! There is no white cast and the consistency is very runny. I'm a fair-light skin tone but the tint isn't noticeable once applied. A medium skin tone could also get away with the tint! My only small complaint is that when I apply it to my skin, it feels so thick. It feels thicker than a night cream when I initially apply it but once I blend it in, it leave a fairly dewy texture
omg I love this sun serum. I started using it this summer and I've been recommending to my friends!!!
I have been using the serum for about two weeks and love the feel and look of it on my skin. I have oily skin but it doesn't enhance any of my natural greasiness. Good sun protection!

This is my new foundation! I love this product for its highly effective SPF and nourishing and healthy ingredients. The tint appears a bit orange out of the bottle, but when blended sufficiently (think 60 second mini facial massage) it just melts into a healthy glow. Great product!!
This is now my favorite sunscreen which was recommended by HotandFlashy . Wears beautifully under makeup and doesn't cake or dry my skin.
Love this product-only thing that is annoying is postage costs a lot ( I bought two bottles to justify the postage)
The R&R dries down matte and wears well under my foundation without any pilling. I have dry, mature skin and this sits well on the skin.
I wear tinted sunblock everyday ! I don't wear foundation and this is perfect for me. Matches skin tone, a light serum, Matt, dries quickly, not sticky, this will be my go to,
Very good skincare and skinshield product. Easy to apply, pleasant and smooth feeling. The color is very nice and it is sheer enough to fit most skin tones. I just wish it had a more mat finish.

avis.titre: Great mineral sunscreen but pricey for amount
avis.texte: Slightly too dark for fair skin. However, I'd rather this over white cast. Great consistency and you can reapply without it pilling. The bottle isn't oversized\filled with air or decorative caps which is great for travel! Note that 1/2 tsp needed to equal 2 grams. It's not very dense so the standard sunscreen recommendation 1/4 tsp (for face and neck) is only 1 gram and wouldn't equate to spf 50 coverage. The bottle has 10.2 tsp. So, you'd get approximately 20 (1/2 tsp) applications from one bottle.

avis.titre: Good but not quite great due to color
avis.texte: There are many things to love about the sun serum. I love its consistency. It goes on very shiny but has a nice dry down. It works very well under makeup. It has a decent price point. I see that it would work for a variety of skin tones. Unfortunately the big drawback for me is the color; my skin tone is a bit too light and too pink for the serum to work color-wise. I look forward to the day when Undefined Beauty offers more shades!

avis.titre: A Little Goes A Long Way
avis.texte: I love this sunscreen. It doesn't take a lot to get full facial coverage and I have no problem with white cast. I just wish I didn't have to rub it in as much but I still have no problem with the product lightening my complexion. Definitely recommend!!

I am fair/light cool toned and most tinted sun screens are too dark and tone is wrong for me. This one started off darker, but I found that once I applied and waited a few mins for it to dry down it looked pretty good. All I needed was a little concealer. I have drier skin, but moisturize well before using. Just looked at my skin after wearing for 7 hours and no settling in lines and skin looks good.
love the finish, gives me a barely there glow. the only issues with this product is that the texture isn't light so it takes a few minutes of rubbing and spreading the product in.

avis.titre: Great product, but expensive for amount that you get.
avis.texte: I really like this. However you should use a quarter of a teaspoon for recommended SPF. makes this very expensive per ounce.

I want to love this! It's perfect for sensitive skin and has amazing ingredients to protect. However, I can't get past the odd tint and smell. I'm medium toned and neutral - but this has a yellow cast a slight glow finish. I am not a fan. Of course, I will use it but won't repurchase.

It feels amazing and smooth on the skin for a mineral sunscreen. I really like the fact it is mineral and 50 spf. If you have very fair skin you probably will not be able to wear this. I really hope they will create more shades because this is such a good sunscreen product. I feel like I can't wear this unless I have a bit of a tan because the shade is too dark. I also really don't like the smell at all. It smells like play dough, but since I really like the way it feels I'm willing to get over that. The smell goes away in about 30 minutes so it's not that bad. Please add more shades!!

avis.titre: An excellent sunblock for dry skin
avis.texte: Love this sunblock. It doesn't sting my eyes. The only downside is that the tint is too dark on me. I wish it has another lighter shade.

Oh wow! I just got this and so far I'm really happy. I have light/fair skin with a neutral undertone that sometimes looks a bit golden/yellow. White casts look obvious on me because although my skin is light, it has some warmth in the undertones.. So far no light cast from this baby

avis.titre: Love it and it's mineral not chemical
avis.texte: Love it and it's mineral l, not chemical. Does r irritate the eyes either.

avis.titre: Product is lightweight, dries fast, & lasts a long time
avis.texte: I like it especially when you're on the go and may need to reapply throughout the day. A little goes a long way, so definitely don't overdo it!

She's super thin. Super beautiful under makeup. It's not oily or greasy. She doesn't have too much coverage but it does leave a slight tint. Loved it. So much product in the bottle too! Oh and amazing amount of sun protection for a skin tint!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: This is a good product, I like how it matches my skin tone and blends well. It can rub off on your clothes at first, but when it dries completely it's good.
I am using the lightest shade and enjoy the slight glow it gives to my skin. It looks beautiful under my foundation, which is light to medium coverage and oil based.

The sun serum had rave reviews which is why I originally purchased it. I liked everything about it (including the brightening effect the peach tint gave which somehow is not as peach with the new version ) except the liquid looked like it expired and was so watery and hard to work with. I wonder if this was just a problem with certain batches cause it wouldn't have been so famous otherwise. The new version in medium i feel a bit too thick/heavy … as if it has too much filler in it. I wonder if there is a happy medium that can be achieved. If only the old version had more consistency in stability. I prefer a lighter feeling version.

avis.titre: Excellent product, but some bad batches
avis.texte: I love this product. It's easy to apply, doesnt pill in the hairline, blends much faster than any other mineral sunscreen I've tried (I use three fingers-worth for my face), and matches my skin tone perfectly while providing some coverage. I find it moisturizing, very protective, and when I reapply it doesnt look like I've put on more product. My friends and coworkers compliment my skin when I wear this. Unfortunately, I've ordered probably 7 or 8 bottles of this product over the years and two were separated and unusable. I replaced them through Ulta with new ones that worked great. It's not a product I'd stock up on during a sale since its shelf life is poor. For that, I'm giving it 4 stars. That said, the good batches are 5 star products.

If you've seen the hype about this sunscreen around the web, know that it is absolutely warranted! I love that this sunscreen is lightweight, leaves no residue, and absorbs completely into the skin. It has a slight tint that gives a natural glow, perfect for no-makeup days but also suitable as the base for a full face of makeup.

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again
avis.texte: Once a day, every day. Mixes and massages well into my face. Lasts the whole day, and no white cast. This sun serum works really well
I have tried so many sunscreens and this (finally) fits the bill. I can wear it under makeup or alone and it looks great! Will buy more for certain.
I have only used it twice so far. I'm finishing up my Elta MD at the moment. I like that R&R is less luminous than Elta when only using tinted sunscreen without foundation.
I am so happy with this sunscreen. It goes on easily, and seems to add moisture to my skin.

I've tried lots of sunscreens and either they leave a ashy cast or feel too greasy. I love one because it's moisturizing and gives my skin a healthy glow without looking like I've melted in the sun. I love the natural ingredients and know that I'm doing the best for my skin when I use it daily.

This is such a beautiful, lightweight formula that gives me just the glow and dewiness I need and desire. It gives the look of your skin but better. And it could be for no makeup days where you want a little bit of extra correction. I am very pale so I am not sure how it works on darker skin tones. I also need to add that it doesn't peel or sting my eyes. Highly recommend it!

I was on the hunt for a new facial SPF. It's hard for me to fall in love with spf becuase I have pretty dry skin and hate any kind of cast, but I had seen a few ads for the R&R on instagram, and knew I had to try it out. This is the best spf I have used to date. It's perfection in a bottle. It's not watery, and not too thick. It's a perfect serum texture and glides right on and sinks right in. I imagine this being wonderful on any skin type. If you are on the fence- I highly suggest you get it! You will not regret it. I cannot wait to try the rest of this beautiful line.
This is my absolute holy grail. So light and hydrating. Packaging is so convenient to carry around in pocket and re applying.

I tried this sunscreen after Angie recommended it. Even though I'm in Australia and have to factor in the shipping and the conversion rate, it is well worth it! Great on my skin and looks amazing. It's a beautiful sunscreen.
The serum feel smooth and gentle on your skin. The tint tone is light, evens the face tone nicely. You can barely see the tint,so it's good as under the makeup serum. I like the product

I was pleasantly surprised by this product! I have tried sun screens in the past that were chalky and thick. This product is amazing! It goes on smooth and does not add color to my skin. Previous sun screens left my skin with a chalky look. I love this product!
By far one of the best mineral sunscreens I have purchased. Blends in really well as a women of color, no cast, hydrating and just feels nice on skin. Love that it's Black-owned!
